ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels in the central field and 25% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated along the trailing margins and scattered focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central region spanning both lobes. A distinct low-intensity (black) band follows the entire trailing edge boundary. The left lobe contains 5-7 large, circular dark blobs clustered in the medial to lateral midsection. The right lobe contains smaller, more dispersed dark focal points.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees and a moderate depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge is relatively smooth with low-amplitude variance. The left lobe trailing edge exhibits significant high-amplitude jaggedness and irregular peaks, particularly near the lateral tip and the median notch transition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep on both lobes. The right lobe follows a continuous curve to a sharp, tapered point. The left lobe trajectory is truncated by an irregular, non-linear pixel boundary at the lateral terminus.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 15 circular dark pixel clusters (3-10 pixel diameter) distributed across the white ventral surface, with higher density observed on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the mid-lateral region of the left lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical trauma/amputation at the distal tip of the left fluke lobe, resulting in a jagged, irregular edge and loss of standard tapered geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical pigmentation pattern with significantly more prominent dark mottling on the left lobe relative to the right lobe.
